sloka: स तु तेन प्रहारेण विह्वलो भृशताडितः।निपपात तदा कुम्भो गतार्चिरिव पावकः ।। ६.७६.९१ ।।
transliteration: sa tu tena prahāreṇa vihvalo bhṛśatāḍitaḥ।nipapāta tadā kumbho gatārciriva pāvakaḥ ।। 6.76.91 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva, the champion pressed his first which shone like the Sun encircled with rays on the chest of Kumbha.
